namespace PubAC14
def WeakSubset (lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2 : Int) : Prop := ∀ x : Int, lo1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi1 → lo2 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi2
def checkNonEmptySubset (lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2 : Int) : Bool := (lo1 ≤ hi1) && (lo2 ≤ lo1) && (hi1 ≤ hi2)
theorem inverted_interval_vacuous : WeakSubset 10 2 0 1 := by sorry
theorem nonEmptySubset_sound (lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2 : Int) (h : checkNonEmptySubset lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2 = true) : (∃ x : Int, lo1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi1) ∧ WeakSubset lo1 hi1 lo2 hi2 := by sorry
end PubAC14
